title: Best 529 Plan 2026
description: Utah, New York, Nevada, Illinois, California 529 plans compared.
lede: Five 529 plans compared by fees and state tax benefits.
methodology: Compared expense ratios, fund variety, state tax benefits.

sections.heading: State vs. out-of-state plan
paragraphs: In-state often offers tax deduction. Out-of-state (Utah, Nevada) often has lower fees.

faqs.a: Use in-state if it offers tax deduction, otherwise pick lowest-fee plan.

utah-myr529.review: Low fees, Vanguard fund options, highly-rated.

new-york-529-direct.review: NY state tax deduction, Vanguard funds.

nevada-vanguard-529.review: Vanguard-managed, no state income tax issue.

illinois-bright-start-529.review: IL state tax deduction, 24 fund options.

california-scholarshare-529.review: TIAA-managed, no state tax deduction (CA quirk).
